steps.text: On your PC, copy your Magic Carpet installs into a gamedata folder (gamedata/Magic Carpet Plus/CARPET.CD/game.gog and, optionally, gamedata/Magic Carpet 2/game.gog with GAME/NETHERW). Download mgc-import from the same release and run: mgc-import bake gamedata/ baked/. Copy the baked folder to /sdcard/mgcarpet/baked/ on the headset. Then open Magic Carpet VR from Library > Unknown Sources and pick a game.

notes: Needs the mgc-import converter (mgc-import-windows.zip or mgc-import-linux.zip in the release). The baked folder has no documented fixed file, so it cannot be a pc-install input with detect yet; once known, model it as a pc-install with preparedWith mgc-import and push to /sdcard/mgcarpet/baked/, and make this guided. The payload has no targetPath. A full install is about 1 GB.
